ct-architect.description: coding-team worker: read-only design, interface contracts and file-ownership matrix for a bounded task. Dispatched by the coding-team Leader only.

ct-researcher.description: coding-team worker: answers one bounded code, documentation or root-cause question with source evidence. Read-only. Dispatched by the coding-team Leader only.

ct-developer.description: coding-team worker: implements an assigned work item, editing only assigned files, optionally with a named focus. Dispatched by the coding-team Leader only.

ct-test-engineer.description: coding-team worker: derives behavioral cases, writes and runs tests including browser end-to-end checks on a stable snapshot. Dispatched by the coding-team Leader only.

ct-reviewer.description: coding-team worker: independent QA review of a stable snapshot; ct-reviewer reviews read-only, ct-reviewer-verify may also run checks. Dispatched by the coding-team Leader only.

ct-security.description: coding-team worker: read-only security, performance and concurrency review bound to an exact snapshot; required at L3 before Gate 2. Dispatched by the coding-team Leader only.
